basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in Portland, Oregon, working as a barista during the day and learning music production during the evenings. I've recently joined Reddit to connect with supportive communities and to find solace as I navigate my own recovery journey. I love watching 'Jeopardy!' and am a huge fan of Jacob Collier's music. In my downtime, I enjoy watching Game Grumps for some laughs. I'm currently single and spend most of my online hours in the late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of music theory and production, mostly self-taught through online resources and experimenting with software. My knowledge about recovery and sobriety is growing, thanks to personal experiences and community support.
